strings.item_ecp_bonedagger_description: Its blade is the spine of a single vertebra, its grip a tail of small ones. Quick, quiet and cruel.
strings.item_ecp_bonesword_description: A blade of bone with a spine running down its middle, a vertebra for a guard and more for a grip.
strings.item_ecp_boneaxe_description: A bone blade set in a vertebra, on a haft of spine. It bites flesh and wood alike.
strings.item_ecp_bonemace_description: A knot of vertebrae on a haft of spine. Heavy enough to crack whatever it meets.
strings.item_ecp_bonespear_description: Long bones for the lower shaft, a spine for the upper, a leaf of bone for a point.
strings.item_ecp_boneatgeir_description: Half long bones, half spine, ending in a curved bone blade and a hooked fang. It keeps the dead at a distance.
strings.item_ecp_bonebow_description: Ribs for limbs and a backbone for a grip. The dead draw it well enough; so can you.
strings.item_ecp_spine_description: A length of an old spine, still hard as stone. The skeletons build their weapons around it.
strings.item_ecp_arrowbone_description: A shaft of bone tipped with a sharpened vertebra. Better than wood, not as good as flint.
strings.item_ecp_bonecrossbow_description: A crossbow of bones, made the way the dead make theirs: a femur for a stock, a spine for a tiller, ribs for a prod. It hits like a club, whatever bolt it looses.
strings.item_ecp_boltboneblunt_description: A bolt of bone with its head ground blunt and no fletching, for the bone crossbow. It breaks bones rather than piercing them.
strings.item_ecp_executionergreataxe_description: The Crypt Executioner's greataxe, its haft strung from vertebrae. It slashes, whirls all the way around, then falls from overhead; the last blow is slow to recover from.
strings.item_ecp_executioneraxehead_description: The bone head of the Crypt Executioner's axe. Set on a haft of spines at the workbench, it swings again.
strings.item_ecp_krakenbeak_description: The kraken's hooked beak: dark horn with an amber edge that could shear through a hull. A smith could set it in a shield.
strings.item_ecp_krakenmeat_description: A thick cut of kraken arm, suckers and all. Cook it on an iron cooking station.
strings.item_ecp_krakenmeatcooked_description: Seared tentacle, rich and chewy. Keeps a crew rowing through the longest night.
strings.item_ecp_shieldkraken_description: Fine wood and silver bound around the kraken's beak. Parry a blow with it and the beak bites back.
strings.notice_step_aside: Bestiary steps aside because Elite Creatures Pack is installed. Remove it to use Bestiary; Meadworks can import its settings. Your world's creatures and items carry over.
strings.notice_workshop_step_aside: Bestiary's creature workshop steps aside because CreatureManager has creature files. Remove it to use the workshop; Meadworks can import its files.
strings.notice_platform_unsupported: Bestiary is not supported on macOS; it stays off.
strings.notice_server_missing: This server does not run Bestiary; Bestiary is off for this session.
strings.compendium_cryptmimic_body: A chest in a burial chamber or sunken crypt may be a dormant mimic. Opening it wakes a fast, lunging attacker. Keep room to retreat and strike between its bites; defeating it releases the chest loot.
strings.compendium_greydwarfslinger_body: Among the greydwarfs, a slinger attacks from a distance with stones. Use cover, close the distance between shots and watch for other greydwarfs nearby.
strings.compendium_rimegiant_body: In the Mountains, a sleeping giant resembles a snowy outcrop. Night, snowstorms or a hit can wake it. Its ice plates absorb blows; fire and blunt damage help break the armor. Move away from its sweeps, slams and thrown boulders.
strings.compendium_kraken_body: The Kraken hunts crewed ships in deep Ocean water. It can seize the ship, strike the hull, bite and blind the crew with ink. Fight its exposed body while avoiding tentacle blows; its defeat releases the held ship and valuable spoils.
strings.compendium_arsenal_creature_body: Armed skeletons appear among the dead in tombs and ruins. Their bone weapons use familiar dagger, sword, axe, mace, spear, atgeir or bow attacks. Watch their reach and recoveries; a defeated skeleton may leave a spine for crafting.
strings.compendium_skeletoncrossbowman_body: The Skeleton Crossbowman fires blunt bone bolts and pauses to reload. Cover blocks its line of fire; close in during the reload. It may drop a spine and spare bolts.
strings.compendium_headsman_body: The Crypt Executioner guards burial chambers with a great axe. Its sweeping blows, spin and axe throw punish a crowded approach, and it raises skeletons during the fight. Move between attacks and keep the summoned dead from surrounding you. It may leave an axehead.
strings.compendium_headsmanskeleton_body: The Executioner raises these skeletons during battle. They give no loot. Clear enough space to fight the Executioner instead of pursuing them for rewards.
strings.compendium_arsenal_body: Collect spines from armed skeletons and use them with bone fragments at a workbench to make the seven bone weapons. Bone arrows use bone fragments. These weapons preserve their familiar attack styles; the server controls whether their recipes are available.
strings.compendium_crossbow_body: A spine, wood, bone fragments and leather scraps make the Bone Crossbow at a workbench. It converts bolt damage to blunt damage and requires a reload after each shot. Blunt bone bolts are crafted from bone fragments.
strings.compendium_greataxe_body: The Executioner can drop an axehead. Combine it with spines at a workbench to make the greataxe. Its combo sweeps, spins and finishes with an overhead blow that has a long recovery. The server controls the recipe and combat values.
strings.compendium_kraken_gear_body: The Kraken leaves beaks, meat and other spoils. Cook its meat on an iron cooking station. A beak, fine wood and silver make the Kraken shield at a forge; a successful parry makes the beak strike back.
strings.piece_ecp_boneballista_description: A small ballista of bones. Hold it to aim and shoot, a turn of 45 degrees either way; it reloads from the bone missiles you carry.
strings.item_ecp_bonemissile_description: A missile for the bone ballista: a long bone shaft that breaks what it hits.
strings.msg_ecp_bal_behind: Stand behind it to hold it
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Turns all of Bestiary on or off. Off: no Bestiary creature spawns and no recipe is offered; creatures and items already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_1_general__compendium_pages_help: Shows the Compendium pages for Bestiary's creatures and items (where found, what it does, how to fight it).
strings.cfg_1_general__workshop_enabled_help: The creature workshop: clone and edit creatures, attacks, AI, factions, projectiles and textures from the workshop files.
strings.cfg_2_crypt_mimic__enabled_help: Crypt mimics. When a crypt first fills its chests, each listed chest may be a mimic instead: it looks exactly like the chest until someone opens it (it bites whoever does) or hits it. Off: no new mimics; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_2_crypt_mimic__chance_help: Percent of the listed chests that are mimics. Only crypts generated after this is on get them.
strings.cfg_2_crypt_mimic__chests_help: The chest prefabs that may be mimics, separated by commas. Hildir's crypt chest (her quest key) and TreasureChest_fCrypt (it also stands in fortresses and troll caves) are left out on purpose.
strings.cfg_2_crypt_mimic__bite_cooldown_help: Seconds after a lunge before it can bite again; meanwhile it hops after you.
strings.cfg_2_crypt_mimic__bite_damage_help: Slash damage of its bite (the lunge and the ambush), before stars (the crypt skeleton's sword: 25).
strings.cfg_2_crypt_mimic__run_speed_help: How fast it bounds after you (the crypt skeleton runs at 4); it wanders at half this.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__enabled_help: Greydwarf slingers: a greydwarf with a slingshot that stands and shoots stones like a skeleton archer, at any range, and never melees. Off: no new slingers; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__share_help: Percent of the greydwarfs spawning in the biomes below that come as slingers instead.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__nests_help: Greydwarf nests spawn them too, not only the wild.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__biomes_help: Where greydwarfs can come as slingers. Several biomes are separated by commas, like BlackForest, Meadows.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__shot_interval_h: Seconds between its shots at the least.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__stone_damage_he: Blunt damage of a stone, before stars (a greydwarf's thrown rock: 10).
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__stone_speed_hel: Meters a second the stone flies (a greydwarf's thrown rock: 12); it arcs onto its target.
strings.cfg_3_greydwarf_slinger__range_help: Distance in meters at which a Greydwarf Slinger starts throwing stones at a target.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__enabled_help: Rime giants: a very rare giant of the Mountains, a troll crusted in plates of ice that sleeps by day like a snowy outcrop. At most one per mountain, ever. Off: no new giants; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__mountains_help: Percent of mountains that hold a giant, fixed by the world seed. Snowy hilltops under about 150 m across don't count. Once a mountain's giant has come it never gets another, even after it dies.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__chance_help: Percent per zone roll, while someone roams a mountain whose giant has not come yet.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__biomes_help: The biomes whose regions count as mountains. Several are separated by commas.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__plates_help: Plates of ice it wears, 0 to 8.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__armored_damage_help: Percent of a physical hit that gets through with every plate on; each plate lost lets an equal part more through.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__shatter_at_help: Percent of its health at which the plates left all break off.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__fire_per_plate_help: Fire damage that breaks one plate (a fire arrow against its weakness: about 33).
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__regrow_delay_help: Seconds unhurt, out of the fight, before the plates grow back.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__regrow_interval_help: Seconds per plate as they grow back.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__sweep_damage_help: Blunt damage of its fist, with heavy knockback (a troll's punch: 60).
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__slam_damage_help: Blunt damage where its fists land in the slam.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__avalanche_damage_help: Blunt damage, plus half as much frost, where the slam's wave rolls over you.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__avalanche_length_help: Meters the wave rolls on flat ground; far further downhill, a few meters uphill. 0 turns the avalanche off.
strings.cfg_4_rime_giant__boulder_damage_help: Frost damage of its ice boulder in the burst where it lands, plus half as much blunt.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__enabled_help: Krakens: a boss of the deep ocean that hunts ships. Outrun it under sail, or it grabs the ship from below and attacks with six tentacles and then its head. Off: no new krakens; one already in the world stays.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__chance_help: Percent per zone roll while a ship with a crew crosses deep ocean. At 0.3 a crew sailing the open sea meets one about every hour or two.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__min_depth_help: Meters of water it needs: it only spawns over water this deep and never follows a ship into shallower water.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__health_help: Its health (Bonemass: 5000, a serpent: 400). The game adds 30% for every other player within 100 m, as for any creature.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__swim_speed_help: Meters a second as it chases. Rowing (about 2) never escapes it; a longship or karve under sail with a fair wind does.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__hunt_range_help: Meters at which it notices a ship. It gives up once the ship is further than this.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__attack_gap_min_help: Seconds from one attack to the next at the least. It attacks one thing at a time: a slam, a bite, ink or a smash.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__attack_gap_max_help: Seconds from one attack to the next at the most; each gap is a random time between the two.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__gap_factor_solo_help: The gap between attacks is this many times longer with one player aboard (three or more: the gap as set).
strings.cfg_5_kraken__gap_factor_pair_help: The gap between attacks is this many times longer with two players aboard.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__tentacle_gap_factor_help: Under the ship the slams come quicker: the gap between them is this many times the attack gap.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__phase_attacks_help: Attacks in each phase: this many tentacle slams under the ship, then this many from the head beside it, and round again.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__slam_damage_help: Blunt damage of a tentacle slamming across the deck.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__ship_damage_help: Damage to the ship each time a tentacle smashes it in the head phase (a longship has 1000 health, a karve 500).
strings.cfg_5_kraken__ship_hit_interval_help: Seconds between tentacle smashes on the ship while the head is up; a smash takes the next attack's turn.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__bite_damage_help: Pierce damage of its beak, at players near the rail.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__ink_damage_help: Blunt damage of the ink it spits.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__ink_blind_help: Seconds the ink covers the screen of a player it hits (dodge or block it and it doesn't), before it fades.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__ink_interval_help: Seconds between its ink spits at the least.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__shield_parry_damage_help: Pierce damage a creature takes when you parry its blow with the Kraken shield (made from the kraken's beak), at quality 1. Players are never bitten.
strings.cfg_5_kraken__shield_parry_damage_per_le: Added to the parry damage for each quality level of the shield above the first.
strings.cfg_6_skeleton_crossbowman__damage_facto: A bolt's damage, as blunt, against the bow of the skeleton archer it replaces (20), before stars. 1: the same as that archer.
strings.cfg_6_skeleton_crossbowman__shot_interva: Seconds between its shots at the least (the skeleton archer's: 4). The whole shot, spanning and loading included, takes about 5.5 of them.
strings.cfg_6_skeleton_crossbowman__bolt_speed_h: Meters a second the bolt flies, straight (the skeleton archer's arrow: 30).
strings.cfg_6_skeleton_crossbowman__range_help: Meters it shoots from (the skeleton archer: 20).
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__craftable_help: The Bone Crossbow, the crossbowmen's crossbow of bones, can be made at the workbench.
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__recipe_help: What it costs, as item:amount:amount per upgrade, separated by commas. Item names are the game's prefab names, like BoneFragments, Wood, DeerHide, TrophySkeleton; the spine is ECP_Spine.
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__workbench_level_hel: The workbench level it needs (its Blunted Bone Bolts too).
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__damage_help: Blunt damage of its own blow, before the bolt's (a Blunted Bone Bolt adds 27 blunt, the game's bone bolt 32 pierce; the Arbalest: 200 pierce).
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__damage_per_level_he: Blunt damage added by each upgrade.
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__reload_time_help: Seconds to span and load it with no Crossbows skill; the skill halves it (the Arbalest: 3.5).
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__bolt_recipe_help: What a batch of Blunted Bone Bolts costs, as item:amount, separated by commas; made at the crossbow's workbench level.
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__bolts_per_craft_hel: Blunted Bone Bolts made at once.
strings.cfg_7_bone_crossbow__bolt_damage_help: Blunt damage a Blunted Bone Bolt adds to the crossbow's own: a flint arrow's, as blunt (flint arrows 27 pierce; the game's bone bolt 32 pierce).
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__enabled_help: All the arsenal skeletons, the crossbowman too, the master switch. Off: none of them spawns, whatever their own switches below say; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_cutthro: The Skeleton Cutthroat (bone dagger) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_swordsm: The Skeleton Swordsman (bone sword) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_axeman_: The Skeleton Axeman (bone axe) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_bonebre: The Skeleton Bonebreaker (bone mace) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_spearma: The Skeleton Spearman (bone spear) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_halberd: The Skeleton Halberdier (bone atgeir) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_bowman_: The Skeleton Bowman (bone bow) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_8_skeleton_arsenal__skeleton_crossbo: The Skeleton Crossbowman (bone crossbow, blunt bone bolts; its shot's numbers are in section 6) spawns in place of some of the game's skeletons that could be archers, wherever and whenever they spawn. Off: no new ones; ones already in the world stay.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__enabled_help: The Crypt Executioner: a skeleton headsman with a bone greataxe, a mini boss waiting in some of the Black Forest's burial chambers. Off: no chamber gets one, and the ones already placed raise none.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__chambers_help: Percent of burial chambers that hold one, decided once per chamber: when it is generated, or for chambers from before the mod when first loaded.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__respawn_days_h: Game days before it comes back to its chamber after it died.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__axehead_chance: Percent chance it drops its axehead, from which the Executioner's Greataxe is made.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__slam_damage_he: Slash damage of the overhead slam, where the axe lands.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__sweep_damage_h: Slash damage of the low sweep across its front, where the axe head passes.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__spin_damage_he: Slash damage of the spin, where its axe head passes.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__throw_damage_h: Slash damage of the thrown axe.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__rear_strike_da: Slash damage of the strike behind it, used when two or more foes are near and one is behind.
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__axe_head_radiu: Meters round the blade's edge that hit in the slam (where the axe lands) and the spin (the ring the head draws; inside it is safe).
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__slam_windup_sp: How much faster than its animation the slam is raised and cocked before it comes down (1 = as animated).
strings.cfg_25_crypt_executioner__summons_help: Skeletons it may have raised at once from its thrown axe's bones; 0 raises none.
strings.cfg_26_executioner_greataxe__recipe_help: Whether the greataxe can be made at the workbench.
strings.cfg_26_executioner_greataxe__slash_help: Slash damage (a fully upgraded Bronze Axe: 55).
strings.cfg_26_executioner_greataxe__chop_help: Chop damage, for trees (a fully upgraded Bronze Axe: 49).
strings.cfg_26_executioner_greataxe__spines_help: Spines (the bone weapons' drop from skeletons) the recipe takes besides the axehead; without the skeleton arsenal, bone fragments take their place.
strings.cfg_26_executioner_greataxe__workbench_l: Workbench level required to craft the Executioner Greataxe.
strings.cfg_28_bone_ballista__enabled_help: A small ballista of bones in the hammer's Misc. tab beside the game's ballista (3 spines, 25 bone fragments), and its Bone Missiles at the workbench (level 2: 5 bone fragments and 2 feathers make 20). Hold it with the use key, aim with the mouse (45 degrees either way), shoot with attack; it reloads from the missiles you carry. Off: neither can be made; ballistas already built stay and still shoot.
strings.cfg_30_workshop__data_folder_help: Folder of the workshop files (creatures, attacks, AI, factions, projectiles, localization, textures), relative to the game folder and inside BepInEx/config.
strings.cfg_30_workshop__hot_reload_help: Workshop files reload when saved; creatures already loaded keep what they have completed.
strings.cfg_30_workshop__texture_sync_help: The server sends its workshop textures to clients, which keep them in a cache by content hash.
strings.cfg_30_workshop__texture_cache_limit_hel: Megabytes of synced workshop textures this client keeps.
